## Description

What happened, or what readability problem should this solve?

## Expected Behavior or Proposal

Describe the expected result or proposed change.

## Rust Examples

Include a minimal reproduction or before-and-after snippets. Reference a shared LEG rule ID when relevant.

## Versions and Configuration

For bugs, include `rustc -Vv`, Clippy and Dylint versions, the rs-legibility-lints version or commit, and relevant lint settings.
